thm:main-finite-homogeneous-stationarity.title: Finite stationary classification and de Sitter convergence
thm:main-finite-homogeneous-stationarity.note: Proved. thm:supp-relative-primitive-floor.plan: (R2)-(R4) are already witnessed in the four-field toy model RenewalGeometry/Certificates/RelativeUpstreamPrimitiveClosure.lean (four_rows_irredundant, four_pairs_remain_separating, downstream_packet_factors) and OrientationCalibrationResidualExact.lean (orientation_absorbed_iff_read_decoder). What blocks a faithful statement is the 'fixed category of finite typed operational-predictive models' with anchored isomorphisms and conservative refinement functors: it does not exist in the library and (R1) 'the rows are sufficient for the reconstruction used below' is a meta-claim about other theorems, so the record needs reformulation (at best R1 becomes a conjunction of the already-proved cited theorems). A cheap partial upgrade is to replace PlaneSection.positiveGram (a scalar) by the 2x2 Gram matrix I_2 with alternating coefficients +-1 so that 'identical positive Gram data' is literal; the categorical closure remains research-level.

thm:supp-calibration-fibre.title: Exact calibration fibre and minimum anchor bank
thm:supp-calibration-fibre.note: calibration_fibre_anchor_bank, for L : R^N -> R^M, b, a solution x0, and injective unit conventions U : R^d -> R^N with LU = 0: (K1) {x | Lx = b} = x0 + ker L and dim ker L = N - rank L; (K2) every injective linear anchor bank ker L -> R^k has k >= dim ker L and a bijective bank with exactly dim ker L anchors exists; (K3) dim (ker L / Im U) = N - rank L - d and the same necessary-and-sufficient anchor count on the quotient PhysicalResidual L U; (K4) for a six-root race with positive rates: the winner law k_b / sum k is invariant under common rescaling, the total rate is multiplied by the rescaling constant (so a nontrivial rescaling changes it), the exponential waiting time of total rate K has mean 1/K, and winner law times total rate recovers every rate. Scoped/disclosed: 'anchor bank' = linear map to R^k, 'determines one calibration' = injectivity; (K3) assumes U injective (d = rank U) as in the earlier partial file; (K4) is stated for the Fin 6 root alphabet.

ass:supp-relational-branch.title: Minimal faithful predictive relation branch
ass:supp-relational-branch.note: Single named object: MinimalFaithfulRelationBranch X A F extends FutureMinimalSerialCell (one source, one target, distinct; involutive reversal swapping endpoints; complete future signature whose equality is the future-minimal identification, minimal_identified_iff) by a symmetry subgroup of Perm X transitive on unordered pairs of distinct endpoints, a relation set of unordered endpoint pairs containing every letter's pair and invariant under the group, and nonemptiness of the letter alphabet. Consequences proved: the relation set has an off-diagonal pair, reversal keeps the unordered pair, and lem:supp-pair-completion (skeleton_complete: every unordered pair of distinct endpoints is a relation).

lem:supp-pair-completion.title: Pair-homogeneous completion
lem:supp-pair-completion.note: dimension_pairwise_completion proves that a relation set R of unordered pairs invariant under a permutation group transitive on off-diagonal pairs and containing one off-diagonal pair contains every off-diagonal pair, i.e. the colour-free skeleton is K_N; the exact version adds the +1/-1 oriented-edge incidence of each primitive relation and the future-minimal parallel-label alternative. Scoped: the assumption's clauses enter as hypotheses on (Gamma, R).

thm:supp-cut-cycle.title: Cut--cycle decomposition
thm:supp-cut-cycle.note: Signed-edge (antisymmetric-matrix) rendering of Lambda^2 R^N with boundary = row sums: d(x∧y) = (Σy)x - (Σx)y, d(u0∧w) = -√N w for mean-zero w (opposite sign convention), Ran d = mean-zero subspace W_N, and the canonical orthogonal decomposition A = cutPart + cyclePart with d(cyclePart) = 0 and dA = 0 iff cutPart = 0 (Ker d = boundary-free currents = Lambda^2 W_N). Scoped: the dimension counts N-1 and C(N-1,2) appear as Ran d = W_N and the arithmetic identity N(N-1)/2 - (N-1) = (N-1)(N-2)/2, not as finrank statements.

thm:supp-k4-selector.title: Minimal faithful $K_4$ selector on the alternating simplex branch
thm:supp-k4-selector.note: dimension_K4_selector proves (i) a nondegenerate alternating form forces even dimension (D1 with dim R t ⊕ W_N = N), (ii) for even N ≥ 3 (nonzero cycle source, D3) N ≥ 4 with r0 = N-1 ≥ 3, r1 = C(N,2) ≥ 6 and equality iff N = 4 (D4 minimality), (iii) the N = 4 oriented Hodge intertwiner; dimension_K4_selector_complete adds the coordinate form of eq. supp-oriented-copy (all sign-covariant alternating tensors vanish for N ≠ 4, unique scalar intertwiner at N = 4). Scoped: the faithful source ranks are encoded by the formulas N-1 and C(N,2) rather than derived from Gram faithfulness (D2); G_rel = K_4 is dimension_pairwise_completion and dim W_4 = 3 is not restated.

cor:supp-regular-graph-k4.title: Alternating-free endpoint--cycle selector
cor:supp-regular-graph-k4.note: For a Mathlib SimpleGraph that is k-regular on ≥ 2 vertices, the balance equation v - 1 = |E| - v + 1 yields (4-k)v = 4 through the handshake identity and forces v = 4, k = 3 and G = ⊤ (literally K_4). Scoped: the equal-rank hypothesis is taken directly as the balance equation (the connected-graph rank formulas v-1 and |E|-v+1 are not derived from source Grams; connectedness is not needed separately).

lem:supp-root-frame.title: Root dyadics span $\Sym_3$
lem:supp-root-frame.note: Clause (A1) of relational_scheduler_ADM: for the six anchored A_3 roots (e1, e2, e3, e2-e1, e3-e1, e3-e2) every real symmetric 3x3 matrix has exactly one expansion Σ_a c_a r_a r_a^T, i.e. the six dyadics form a basis of Sym_3.

lem:supp-race-score.title: Winner--waiting score is faithful
lem:supp-race-score.note: Clause (A3) integrates the race law k_a e^{-Kt} dt against s_b s_c with s_b = 1_{A=b} - k_b T and proves E[s_b s_c] = δ_bc k_b/K; clause (A3') proves the winner law k_b/K is invariant under a common rescaling of all rates. Scoped: the index set is the six root classes Fin 6 with rates k_a (not the twelve oriented branches; the computation is index-generic), and the covariance formula diag(p) - pp^T of the winner indicator is not stated (only the scale loss).

thm:supp-adm-frame.title: Complete finite ADM frame
thm:supp-adm-frame.note: adm_frame_complete bundles: (A1) the six root dyadics r_a r_a^T are a basis of Sym_3 (rate sums <-> B_h); (A2) the rate-difference map is onto R^3 with kernel exactly the span of the three tetrahedral face cycles, of dimension 3; existence: the boxed formula g = rho^{2/3}(det B)^{1/3} B^{-1}, N = rho^{1/3}(det B)^{1/6} satisfies sqrt(det g) = rho and N^2 g^{-1} = B; uniqueness (adm_inversion_unique, new): every N > 0, g with det g > 0 solving B = N^2 g^{-1}, rho = sqrt(det g) equals the boxed pair (determinants give N^6 = rho^2 det B, positivity fixes N, then g = N^2 B^{-1}). Scoped: 'B succ 0' is used only through det B > 0 (the positive-definite hypothesis implies it); positivity of g is used through det g > 0.

lem:supp-fast-clock.title: Fast-clock lower bound
lem:supp-fast-clock.note: Clause (A5): if v·(h^2 Σ_a k_a r_a r_a^T v) ≥ c|v|^2 for all v then 3c ≤ 2h^2 Σ_a k_a, i.e. Σ_a k_a ≥ 3c/(2h^2), which is the paper's bound with R^2 = 2 = max ‖r_a‖^2 for the concrete A_3 roots (and hence implies the bound for every admissible R ≥ √2). The concluding O(h^{-1}) collapse remark is not formalized.

lem:supp-positive-krein-distinct.title: Positive geometry and Krein signature are distinct layers
lem:supp-positive-krein-distinct.note: positive_krein_distinct_layers: for a positive functional tau (tau(a* a) >= 0 in real part) on a complex *-algebra, the word Gram K(v,w) = tau(v* w) of any word family with the orientation record theta adjoined (index type iota + Unit) is positive semidefinite and its old block is unchanged (wordGram_adjoin_positive, via sum conj(c_v) c_w K(v,w) = tau(a* a)); every positive combination sum c_a r_a r_a^T of the A_3 root dyadics a3SchedulerRoot has no negative direction (its quadratic form is sum c_a (r_a.v)^2) and, if it is an involution, it is the identity (eq_one_of_involution_nonneg) - so it cannot replace the Krein involution; the Krein form <u, Ju> is positive on the +1 eigenspace and negative on the -1 eigenspace (indefinite when both are nonzero), and a positive Krein form forces J = 1. Scoped: the word-Gram hierarchy is modelled abstractly as the Gram of a word family for a positive functional (the paper's proof), not tied to a specific finite history algebra.

thm:supp-signature-minimality.title: Irreducible sign and Lorentzian inertia before Clifford realization
thm:supp-signature-minimality.note: Proved (supplement version of prop:main-signature-minimality). Encoding: the positive spatial form g on W_4 is a positive definite Hermitian matrix D on Fin 3; the geometric extension retaining D and adjoining exactly one independent nondegenerate signed line is the orthogonal block matrix oneLineSignedExtension c D on Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 with c ≠ 0, and 'signed' (protected orientation supplying the sign opposite to the positive restriction) is c < 0. supp_signature_minimality: (a) the positive packet cannot supply a negative direction (quadForm D ≥ 0 everywhere, negInertia D = 0); (b) c = -a^2 for a unique a > 0, q(τt+w) = -a^2 τ^2 + g(w,w) (eq:supp-signature-inertia), inertia (neg,pos,null) = (1,3,0), the overall-sign reversal -q has (3,1,0), and Sylvester's law makes the count invariant under every invertible change of basis X ↦ X^H q X. No Clifford representation is used. Disclosed: the independence of the protected orientation row from the positive packet (thm:supp-relative-primitive-floor) enters only as the hypothesis that the signed line is adjoined orthogonally/independently; a line adjoined with the same sign as g would give a definite form, which is why the opposite-sign clause is a hypothesis (as in the paper's proof).

lem:supp-clifford-cell.title: Depth-two Lorentzian Clifford cell
lem:supp-clifford-cell.note: The matrices of eq. clifford-main (γ^0 = -i X⊗I, γ^1 = Z⊗Z, γ^2 = Z⊗Y, γ^3 = Y⊗I on C^2⊗C^2) are defined verbatim; anchor_external_clifford proves (γ^0)^2 = -1, (γ^a)^2 = 1 and all six mixed anticommutators vanish, and clifford_algebra_top proves Algebra.adjoin C {γ^μ} = ⊤, i.e. the four generators generate M_4(C).

cor:supp-lorentzian-square.title: Lorentzian principal square
cor:supp-lorentzian-square.note: lorentzian_symbol_square: for any generators with (gamma^0)^2 = -1, gamma^0 anticommuting with the gamma^a and {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 delta, and any coframe E with E E^T = g^{-1}, the symbol sigma = N^{-1}(xi_0 - beta.xi) gamma^0 + sum_a (sum_i E_{ia} xi_i) gamma^a satisfies sigma^2 = [-(N^{-1}(xi_0 - beta.xi))^2 + xi.(g^{-1} xi)] 1 (eq:dirac-square-main); anchor_lorentzian_symbol_square instantiates it with the concrete eq:clifford-main matrices gamma0, gammaDir = (gamma1, gamma2, gamma3) of AnchorClifford.lean. Inertia clause (lorentzCharForm_inertia): for N > 0 and g^{-1} positive definite, the characteristic form is carried by the invertible substitution xi_0 = N eta_0 + beta.eta, xi = eta (inverse displayed) to the Sylvester block form -eta_0^2 + eta^T g^{-1} eta, the time line (1,0) is negative and the form is positive definite on the 3-dimensional graph subspace {(beta.xi, xi)}: inertia (1,3) in the convention (-,+,+,+). Disclosed: inertia is expressed by this explicit Sylvester normal form rather than through the posInertia/negInertia indices of SignedHaynsworthInertia.lean; 'g succ 0' is used as positive definiteness of g^{-1}.

thm:supp-determining-kernel.title: Terminating determining-field and accepted-kernel compiler
thm:supp-determining-kernel.note: determiningFieldAcceptedKernelCompiler: on a finite word-record machine the quotient by literal all-future-signature equality is a right congruence through which every primitive update and every future Read factors uniquely (MinimalRecordExact), and the grouped resolved-branch table Σ_{a: step a r ∈ q'} p r a is the unique kernel reproducing all post-accepted class probabilities; refinement_stabilizes and stable_eq_wordEqv prove on a finite record automaton that partition refinement started from the immediate coordinates stabilizes by round |R|-1 with strict rounds bounded, and that the stable partition is exactly future-word equivalence. Scoped: two Lean models (WordRecordMachine and the (out,u) automaton) rather than one; the 1/p_acc normalization is absorbed into the branch probabilities.

thm:supp-reward-pressure.title: Table-derived renewal pressure and action-slope reconstruction
thm:supp-reward-pressure.note: For a finite law p > 0 (Σp = 1), duration τ > 0 and a linear reward synthesis G, the finite-sum Laplace transform L(q,r) has for every q exactly one root r = P(q) (global, not only near 0), P(0) = 0, the directional derivative of P at 0 is π(v) = -E[g_v]/E[τ], the tilted log-likelihood has derivative S v = -G v - π(v)τ at 0, and G = -S - Tπ. Scoped: analyticity of P is not formalized (only existence/uniqueness of the root and directional differentiability at the origin, obtained without the analytic implicit function theorem).

cor:supp-pressure-jet.title: Pressure-jet reconstruction of mixed action blocks
cor:supp-pressure-jet.note: pressure_second_deriv proves d^2/dt^2 P(tv)|_0 = E[τ]^{-1} E[(S v)^2], the diagonal of D^2P(0) = τ̄^{-1} S*S (the bilinear form follows by polarization, which is not restated), duration_slope proves δ(v) = E[τ · S v] = T*S, and pressure_jet_gram proves the matrix identity G*G = S*S + δ*π + π*δ + m_2 π*π from G = -S - Tπ and T*T = m_2; pressure_hessian_psd gives τ̄^{-1} S*S ⪰ 0.

thm:supp-common-action.title: Finite common-action exactness
thm:supp-common-action.note: On a finite real Hilbert cochain complex with d1∘d0 = 0: α is a coboundary iff d1 α = 0 and all periods ⟨rep_b, α⟩ vanish on a certified family of cycle representatives spanning cycles modulo two-cell boundaries (the H_1 basis); the canonical exact/harmonic/coexact decomposition is derived and gives dist(α, Ran d0)^2 ≤ ‖P_har α‖^2 + σ^{-2}‖d1 α‖^2 with the coexact singular-value floor σ as input; path integration telescopes and one anchor makes S unique when ker d0 consists of constants (connectedness). Scoped hypotheses: the H_1 representative certificate, the σ floor, connectedness for uniqueness.

thm:supp-action-stationarity.title: Quantitative accepted-action stationarity
thm:supp-action-stationarity.note: Kernel-integrated conclusions for a stationary law K∘ν = ν of the accepted kernel: ∫D_Ψ ≤ η Δ̄, ∫‖y-θ‖^2 ≤ (2η/m) Δ̄, and ∫S dν ≤ (4Λ_Φ/m + 4M^2(1+ηℓ)^2/(m^2 η)) Δ̄ for every 0 ≤ S ≤ m^{-1}‖∇A‖^2 (the G^{-1} ⪯ m^{-1}I rendering of the stationarity form); the Lean constant 4Λ_Φ/m is ≤ the paper's 4Λ_Φ^2/(m μ_Φ) because Λ_Φ ≥ μ_Φ, so the paper's admissible constant follows. prop:supp-physical-test-stationarity.title: Cutoff-aware stationarity on the determining test core
prop:supp-physical-test-stationarity.note: Proved as three theorems matching the three claims. (1) eq:main-physical-stationarity (physical_test_stationarity): in the chart setting of thm:supp-action-stationarity (AcceptedBregmanStationarityExact: Fisher potential, common action, accepted Markov kernel with stationary probability law nu, all the chart constants), with the positive chart Gram G(theta) >= m I and a represented test lift v with budget <v,G v> <= b = B_{X,K}(k)^2 (eq:main-test-lift-budget; the sup over supp nu is encoded as a bound at every field value) and measurable first variation <grad A, v>, one gets E_nu <grad A(theta), v(theta)>^2 <= b * C_X * Delta-bar with C_X the boxed constant of integral_stationarity_form_le; the duality step is inner_sq_le_of_gram_budget (|<g,v>|^2 <= m^{-1}|g|^2 <v,Gv>). (2) mean-square convergence on the core under eq:supp-scaled-test-gap: tendsto_meanSquare_of_scaled_gap (squeeze). (3) common coupling: on one measure space carrying the cutoff variables Y X m (cutoff X : N, core test m : N) with E[(Y X m)^2] <= b X m -> 0 in X for every m, exists_subseq_ae_tendsto_of_meanSquare / _of_integral_sq_le produce a strictly increasing deterministic cutoff sequence phi along which a.e. every Y (phi j) m -> 0; proof = the paper's diagonal choice b(phi j, m) <= 2^-j for m <= j (exists_strictMono_diagonal), Tonelli (lintegral_tsum) + ae_lt_top' for the a.s. finite sum, terms -> 0, and ae_all_iff over the countable core; no independence used. physical_test_stationarity_core bundles (2)+(3). Disclosed: (1) and (2)-(3) are separate theorems (the coupling is abstracted as second-moment bounds b X m, which (1) supplies cutoff by cutoff); the remark on extending zero from the core to all determining tests by uniform continuity is not formalised (it is not part of the statement).

cor:supp-gibbs-gap.title: Finite Gibbs/KL certificate
cor:supp-gibbs-gap.note: For a strictly positive finite reference row p, cost c and η > 0, the Gibbs row q* of eq. main-gibbs-row is a strictly positive probability row, uniquely minimizes Σ q c + η^{-1} KL(q‖p), and the excess objective of any row q equals exactly η^{-1} KL(q‖q*) (zero iff q = q*). Scoped: the compared row (K^acc(·|θ)) must be strictly positive.

def:supp-spatial-dirichlet.title: Spatial Dirichlet normalization
def:supp-spatial-dirichlet.note: Definition encoded: FiniteWeightedGraph bundles positive vertex masses and symmetric nonnegative conductances; finiteSpatialEnergy c f = (1/2) sum_u sum_v c_uv (f u - f v)^2 is the ordered-pair form of E^sp; the mass-weighted Laplacian in function coordinates is laplacianApply (symmetric coordinates: symmetricLaplacian), eigenvalues and heat semigroup are eigenvalue / heatApply. The normalization identity <f, Delta^sp f>_{L^2(mu)} = E^sp(f) (eq:supp-spatial-dirichlet) is now proved in function coordinates (laplacianApply_dirichletForm; symmetric-coordinate form symmetricLaplacian_quadraticForm). The Markov-semigroup remark is fully encoded: L^q(mu) contraction of e^{-t Delta} for every real q >= 1 (heatApply_weightedLq_le, Jensen on the stochastic rows plus detailed balance), L^1 (heatApply_weightedL1_le) and L^infinity (heatApply_sup_le). The mean-zero projection P_0 and T(t) = e^{-t Delta} P_0 have no separate name; they are used inline in OperationalSobolevWeylFiniteGraph.lean (positiveHeatColumn).

lem:supp-half-volume-sobolev.title: Cut inequality implies the half-volume $L^1$ Sobolev bound
lem:supp-half-volume-sobolev.note: For g ≥ 0 and the cut inequality I μ(A)^{2/3} ≤ h·cap(A) on every subset A of supp g, I ‖g‖_{L^{3/2}(μ)} ≤ (h/2) ΣΣ c_uv |g u - g v| (ordered pairs, i.e. h Σ_edges), via the layer-cake expansion, weighted Minkowski at exponent 3/2 and the finite coarea identity. Scoped: the half-volume hypothesis is encoded as the cut inequality holding on subsets of the support of g.

lem:supp-l6-poincare.title: Discrete $L^6$ Sobolev and Poincar\'e inequalities
lem:supp-l6-poincare.note: With the cut inequality I·min(μ(A), μ(A^c))^{2/3} ≤ h·cap(A), the degree bound h^2 Σ_u c_uv ≤ D μ_v and μ(V) ≤ V*, every mean-zero f satisfies Σ μ f^6 ≤ ((128D/I^2) E(f))^3 (i.e. ‖f‖_6^2 ≤ C_S E), Σ μ f^2 ≤ V*^{2/3} C_S E(f), and every positive eigenvalue of the weighted Laplacian is ≥ C_P^{-1}; the half-support constant 32D/I^2 and the weighted-median centering step are separate lemmas.

lem:supp-nash-counting.title: Nash inequality, ultracontractivity, and spectral counting
lem:supp-nash-counting.note: Nash: (Σ μ f^2)^{5/3} ≤ C_S E(f) (Σ μ|f|)^{4/3} from the L^6 Sobolev bound; the heat differential inequality is integrated (FiniteHeatColumn.l2_decay) to ‖T(t)f‖_2^2 ≤ ‖f‖_1^2 (3C_S/(4t))^{3/2}, giving Tr T(t) ≤ 4V*(3C_S/(2t))^{3/2} on the actual weighted-graph spectrum and N(R) ≤ 1 + 4e^{3/2} V* (C_S R)^{3/2} at t = 3/(2R). Scoped: the ultracontractive bound is formalized through the mean-zero heat columns ‖T(t/2)δ_v‖ and the diagonal trace identity rather than as an explicit L^1→L^∞ operator norm.

thm:supp-spatial-screen.title: Operational Sobolev, Poincar\'e, and compact-screen bounds
thm:supp-spatial-screen.note: Proved on a finite weighted graph (masses m_v > 0, symmetric nonnegative conductances c, cell scale h > 0, efficient capacities u). The cut constants of eq:main-cut-constant are encoded as cutConstant w = sInf of the finite family of half-volume cut ratios w(∂A)/μ(A)^{2/3} (efficientCutConstant u = I^eff, spatialCutConstant h = I^sp with weights h c; the infimum is attained, exists_minimizing_cut, and equals 0 when no half-volume cut exists). cutConstant_comparison derives a₋ I^sp ≤ I^eff ≤ a₊ I^sp (eq:main-cut-comparison) from the edgewise comparison a₋ h c ≤ u ≤ a₊ h c; spatialCutConstant_ge_of_efficient gives I^sp ≥ I_*/a₊ from I^eff ≥ I_*; spatialCutMargin_of_le converts I^sp ≥ I into the two-sided cut margin I·min(μ(A), μ(Aᶜ))^{2/3} ≤ h c(∂A) for every A (eq:supp-cut-isoperimetry, complement case by cut-capacity symmetry). The main theorem renewalSpatialPositiveScreen_of_efficientCut then assembles, under μ(V) ≤ V_*, the weighted degree bound h² Σ_u c_uv ≤ D m_v, the comparison and I^eff ≥ I_* > 0, the full RenewalSpatialPositiveScreen package with constant I_*/a₊: L⁶ Sobolev (C_S = 128 D/(I_*/a₊)²), Poincaré (C_P = V_*^{2/3} C_S), positive spectral floor C_P⁻¹, Weyl count N(R) ≤ 1 + 4 e^{3/2} V_* (C_S R)^{3/2}, and the compact-screen tail Σ_{λ_j > R} |⟨φ_j, f⟩|² ≤ R⁻¹ 𝓔(f) (eq:supp-screen-count-tail, the spectral-coefficient form of ‖(I − P_R) f‖² ≤ R⁻¹ 𝓔(f)). Neck obstruction: neck_witness shows that for a half-volume cut of positive capacity the potential φ = 1_A/u(∂A) has ordered-pair total variation (1/2)ΣΣ u |dφ| = 1 and pairs with the demand b_A of eq:main-cut-demand to μ(A)^{2/3}/u(∂A); neck_witness_of_minimizing_cut gives exactly (I^eff)⁻¹ for a minimizing cut, and tendsto_inv_atTop_of_tendsto_zero sends it to +∞ along any family with I^eff → 0⁺ (eq:main-neck-obstruction). The 'zero-capacity cut retained as disconnected support' clause is a definitional remark and is not formalized separately. Scoped hypotheses: 0 ≤ a₋, 0 < a₊, 0 < D, V_*, h.

prop:supp-compact-upgrade.title: Compact positive-screen upgrade
prop:supp-compact-upgrade.note: screen_strong_convergence: a norm-bounded weakly convergent sequence Z_n ⇀ Z with screens S_{n,R} → S_R in operator norm, S_R completely continuous (the Hilbert-space form of compactness) and uniformly small tails converges strongly (the explicit four-term split); strong_convergence_transfer passes strong convergence through a uniformly bounded strongly convergent operator family (A_X^{-1/2} → A^{-1/2}), giving Y_X → Y. Scoped: boundedness of Z_n is a hypothesis rather than derived from weak convergence, and the final L^1 convergence of bounded quadratic insertions is not restated.

thm:supp-face-linearization.title: Derivative-free renewal face linearization
thm:supp-face-linearization.note: Exact branch: halving symmetry plus quasi-additivity kill the additivity defect (2^{-n} scaling) so A is additive; additivity plus boundedness near 0 gives a unique continuous real-linear functional, and the localized version does this on a halving-closed neighbourhood U (agreement on U). Stable branch: summable adjacent defects |L_{m+1}z - L_m z| ≤ ε_m‖z‖ and additivity defects η_m → 0 give a unique continuous linear limit with pointwise convergence that is uniform on norm-bounded sets. Scoped: the stable branch assumes one approximant L_{m0} is continuous at 0.

thm:supp-memory-short.title: Complete resolved-memory subtraction
thm:supp-memory-short.note: With faithful blocks ρ_ω = exp(H_ω) of unit trace and Hermitian perturbations evaluated along the plane z = t x + u y, M_cq(0) = 0, both first derivatives vanish, and the mixed second derivative equals the branch-mean covariance Σ p_ω (m_ω(x) - x̄)(m_ω(y) - ȳ) plus the Kubo-Mori integrals Σ p_ω ∫_0^1 Tr(ρ^s K̃_x ρ^{1-s} K̃_y) ds, each summand nonnegative (Duhamel/BKM proved from scratch); A_sh = A_coarse - M_cq is the definition shortedScore. Scoped: directions are evaluated on two-dimensional planes, which determines the full bilinear Hessian.

thm:supp-palatini-torsion.title: Connection stationarity and the torsion alternative
thm:supp-palatini-torsion.note: palatini_torsion_core proves the two-sided inverse of αI + β⋆ from ⋆^2 = -1 (the Lean names the ⋆-coefficient α, same identity as eq. supp-palatini-inverse) and ‖T‖ ≤ κ^{-1}‖w‖ from a singular-value floor; connection_stationarity_euler derives -D(PB) - Σ = 0 from stationarity against every perturbation, given the covariant integration-by-parts identity as a hypothesis; cartan_injective proves injectivity of K_e(T) = T^I∧e^J - e^I∧T^J by the coefficient index chase on Fin 4; the packet combines these into T = 0. Scoped: the identification of the Euler source with P_{α,β} K_e(T) enters as a hypothesis (hCartanStationary), and injectivity is passed to the packet as a hypothesis discharged by cartan_injective.

lem:supp-coframe-interpolation.title: Strong interpolation for the reconstructed coframes
lem:supp-coframe-interpolation.note: Proved.
